notes: Show-level bench for the curation engine, per docs/brief/03_CURATION_SPEC.md. Carried-over shows (already referenced in data/session.json) were not re-verified via iTunes -- only their existing apple_collection_id was reused, plus feed_url already verified in docs/research/fusion-candidates.md and docs/research/other-slot-candidates.md by prior research passes in this project.
